title: Mirror Strip Sunrise Bed – Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
5-Year Frame Warranty · Free Delivery Across Great Britain · Handmade in West Yorkshire · Free Fabric Swatches. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay. Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches before you buy.

The Mirror Strip Sunrise Bed is an upholstered bed frame with elegant mirror strip detailing across a deeply padded headboard, catching the light for a subtle, glamorous finish that suits modern and traditional bedrooms. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury on a solid timber frame, from £285.99 in Single 3ft to £428.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

What is an upholstered bed frame?

An upholstered bed frame is a solid timber bed base with a fabric-covered headboard (and often footboard), padded for comfort and finished in a colour or texture of your choice — unlike a metal or bare-wood frame, it adds softness, warmth and a tailored look to a bedroom. The Mirror Strip Sunrise takes this a step further with reflective strip detailing woven into the upholstery, from £285.99.

Deeply padded and finished in your choice of fabric, this bed frame is built on a solid timber base for lasting support.

Ottoman, drawers or plain frame?

Plain upholstered frame — this bed. No built-in storage, the lowest and lightest look, and standard under-bed boxes fit beneath. Choose it if you already have storage elsewhere. From £285.99.

Divan with drawers — fixed drawers built into the base (Cambridge, Oxford and Sussex Panel Storage Beds, from £259.99). No lifting, and you can open one drawer at a time, but you need clear floor in front of the drawer side.

Gas lift ottoman — the whole mattress platform lifts on hydraulic struts, giving the most storage of the three: end-lift from £220.99 or side-lift from £249.99.

You're viewing: a plain upholstered frame with no built-in storage.

Will it fit?

Mattress sizes below are UK standards. Measure the wall the bed will sit against, then the floor space left in front, and leave at least 60cm walking space at one side. Check ceiling slopes and low windows before choosing a tall headboard.

Size Mattress (UK standard) Frame Price
Single (3FT) 90 x 190cm Solid timber, upholstered headboard £285.99
Small Double (4FT) 120 x 190cm Solid timber, upholstered headboard £318.99
Standard Double (4FT6) 135 x 190cm Solid timber, upholstered headboard £337.99
King (5FT) 150 x 200cm Solid timber, upholstered headboard £370.99
Super-King (6FT) 180 x 200cm Solid timber, upholstered headboard £428.99

Still unsure? See our UK bed sizes guide or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com with your room measurements and we'll tell you which size fits.

Features:

  • Mirror strip detailing across the headboard
  • Deeply padded upholstered headboard
  • Solid timber frame construction
  • Available in Single 3ft, Small Double 4ft, Double 4ft6, King 5ft, Super King 6ft
  • Handmade in the UK

Fabrics: Available in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. Custom fabric and colour options available on request. Order free fabric swatches.

Delivery: free delivery across Great Britain, handmade to order in West Yorkshire. Complete the set with our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, from £142.99.

Mattress compatibility

This is a plain frame with no built-in storage, so standard under-bed boxes fit beneath. Order the size that matches your mattress (see the table above), or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99.

Customisation

Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone fabrics, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches let you check the colour at home.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

FAQ

What makes the Mirror Strip Sunrise different?

It has reflective mirror strip detailing across the upholstered headboard, on top of the deep padding and solid timber frame.

Does it have storage?

No, it is a plain upholstered frame. For built-in storage look at our ottoman beds, such as the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base.

Which size should I choose?

Measure your room and see our UK bed sizes guide, or email us your measurements and we will suggest a size.

Is delivery really free?

Yes. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) and usually takes 3–5 working days from our own team. Northern Ireland delivery is £90.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.
